title: WarRoomLive event envelope
description: Wire contract for every message on the warroom.events topic. Producers: backend OutboxPublisher (from outbox_events rows written by OutboxRecorder and the collab service). Consumers dedupe on eventId. Additive payload changes are allowed within a schemaVersion; breaking changes bump it. A hosted schema registry replaces this in-repo contract when multiple teams produce events.

eventId.description: Unique per event; the deduplication key for at-least-once delivery.

eventType.description: Dot-separated domain event name, e.g. chat.message.created.
